subject: Context & Output Profiling — Pricing follow-up and next steps
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
To: Max Turner <max.turner@syncquip.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-04-29T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call recap: Context profiling & pricing next steps

Hi Max —

Thanks again for taking the time earlier today. Quick recap and a few asks so we can size pricing and next steps correctly: 

Call recap (short):
- SyncQuip use case: intelligent content tagging + customer support summarization across platforms (multi-source long context ingestion).
- Goal: replace rule-based pipeline and serve embeddings + generation for summaries and actions.
- Key constraint: cost sensitivity — target budget range for the initial pilot is $20k–$40k/month.

Immediate asks we discussed:
1) Sample token distribution (can be a small export): average prompt tokens, average completion tokens, and a histogram / bucketed % for long-context cases (8k / 32k / 128k windows).
2) Monthly token volumes (prompts vs completions) and expected growth in 6 months.
3) Any compliance / data residency constraints (you mentioned US-only today).

Next steps (proposed):
- Can you send a redacted sample CSV of 200–500 rows with a representative prompt+output length column? (We can accept a drive link or attach directly)
- We’ll run a quick cost projection and send a blended $/1M token estimate plus options for hosted vs reserved capacity by EOD tomorrow.
- If that looks good, propose a short follow-up on Wed (30 min) to walk pricing + pilot terms.

Attachments: call-recording-link.txt (link to recording)

Thanks — catching the key numbers will let us model 8k/32k/128k window economics explicitly.

—
Naomi Feldman
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
naomi@redwood.com

From: Max Turner <max.turner@syncquip.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-04-29T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: Context profiling & pricing next steps

Naomi / team —

Thanks for the recap. Attaching the sample export (context-sample.csv) as discussed — redacted IDs only. Highlights from our side:

- Monthly volumes (current): ~120M prompt tokens / ~180M completion tokens = ~300M tokens total per month.
- Budget: target pilot budget is in the $20k–$40k/mo range, with potential to expand if unit economics are favorable.
- Typical lengths (observed averages across the sample):
  • Average prompt tokens (mean): 850 tokens
  • Average completion tokens (mean): 1,150 tokens
  • Median prompt tokens: ~420 tokens (distribution is skewed by long-context jobs)

- Long-context tail (approx % of requests that require larger windows):
  • ~12% require >8k context (spans collections + multi-doc retrieval)
  • ~3% require >32k context
  • ~0.5% require occasional >128k for full-archive reconstruction (rare, but business-critical for legal requests)

- Caching: we have moderate prefix reuse for templated prompts (estimated effective cache hit ~8–12%).

I uploaded the CSV to the Drive link you shared and attached a local copy as well. Let me know if you need longer samples.

—
Max Turner
Head of ML Platform, SyncQuip
max.turner@syncquip.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Max Turner <max.turner@syncquip.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-04-30T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Quick pricing sketch based on provided distribution

Max / team —

Appreciate the sample, Max — that helped a lot. Based on the volumes and the context-length tail you shared, here is a concise ballpark pricing and configuration readout. Assumptions: throughput is steady, average token numbers per message as provided, and we assume Redwood batching + KV caching yields ~10% effective cost reduction for the repeated prefixes you mentioned.

Option A — Hosted (pay-as-you-go, blended):
- 8k window workload: $5 / 1M tokens
- 32k window workload: $9 / 1M tokens
- 128k window workload: $20 / 1M tokens
Blended price (given your distribution: 85.5% under 8k, 11.5% 8k–32k, 3% >32k but <128k, 0.5% 128k excursions) => blended ~= $7.25 / 1M tokens

Option B — Dedicated/Reserved (12-month commit, recommended if you want predictable unit economics):
- Baseline blended reserved price: $5.50 / 1M tokens (for the committed volume tier we estimate for 300M tokens/mo)
- Additional premium for ultra-long-window support (128k on-call): +$0.50–1.50 / 1M for the portion of traffic routing to specialty nodes (we can scope exact infra cost with infra team)

Quick math against your target:
- At blended $7.25 / 1M, 300M tokens => ~$2,175 / month? No — important check: (300M / 1M) * 7.25 = $2,175 — this is per million unit pricing; please note this is modelled per million tokens aggregated (prompts+completions).
- Pilot budget mismatch: your $20k–$40k/mo target gives flexibility for additional features, integration, and professional services. We can structure a pilot with a credit toward committed spend to align to your $20k baseline.

Pilot proposal (what I recommend):
1) 2-month pilot on Hosted with a $25k pilot credit (applied to usage) + 10% onboarding discount for evals/monitoring.
2) Parallel sizing run of a small dedicated instance in week 3 to validate latency targets and ultra-long-window behavior; we’ll model cost delta and provide a committed pricing sheet if you decide to move to Reserved.

I attached a basic pricing-model-v2.xlsx showing the blended math per-window and the sensitivity to % long-tail. If this looks directionally right, Naomi / Karthik and I can prepare a formal pilot SOW + mutual action plan.

—
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com

Attachment: pricing-model-v2.xlsx (xlsx)
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
To: Max Turner <max.turner@syncquip.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-04-30T11:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick pricing sketch based on provided distribution

Max — thanks for the prompt turnaround and the CSV. Two quick items: 

1) Can you confirm the 0.5% 128k events are spread across ~10 customers (i.e., not one-off megadumps)? If it’s concentrated, we’ll scope a per-request special handling path rather than sizing infra for the peak.

2) We’ll schedule the 30-min follow-up tomorrow at 10am PT to walk the pilot SOW and the pricing worksheet with your infra lead. Karthik, Marissa — I’ll send the calendar invite.
